text: How do I reset my password?
reference_answer: Click Forgot Password on the sign in page and follow the emailed link.

evidence_spans.quote: To reset your password, click Forgot Password on the sign in page and follow the emailed link to choose a new password.

text: How often are invoices generated?
reference_answer: Invoices are generated monthly and emailed as a PDF.

evidence_spans.quote: Invoices are generated monthly and emailed as a PDF. You can download past invoices from the Billing tab in your account settings.

text: How many days do I have to request a refund?
reference_answer: Refunds are issued within 14 days of purchase if the product is unused.

evidence_spans.quote: Refunds are issued within 14 days of purchase if the product is unused. Contact support with your order number to request a refund.

text: How long does standard shipping take?
reference_answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days.

evidence_spans.quote: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and is available at checkout.

text: How do I delete my account?
reference_answer: Go to Account Settings and select Delete Account.

evidence_spans.quote: To delete your account, go to Account Settings and select Delete Account. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

text: How do I enable two factor authentication?
reference_answer: Enable it in Security Settings to add a one time code from an authenticator app.

evidence_spans.quote: Enable two factor authentication in Security Settings to add a one time code from an authenticator app at sign in.

text: What is the API rate limit?
reference_answer: The API allows 100 requests per minute per API key.

evidence_spans.quote: The API allows 100 requests per minute per API key. Exceeding this limit returns a 429 status code until the window resets.

text: How do I export my data?
reference_answer: Export all your data as a CSV file from the Privacy tab.

evidence_spans.quote: You can export all your data as a CSV file from the Privacy tab. Exports are prepared within 24 hours and emailed to you.

text: How do I cancel my subscription?
reference_answer: Open Billing and choose Cancel Plan.

evidence_spans.quote: To cancel your subscription, open Billing and choose Cancel Plan. Your plan remains active until the end of the billing period.

text: What are the support hours?
reference_answer: Monday through Friday from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time.

evidence_spans.quote: Support is available Monday through Friday from 9am to 6pm Eastern Time. Email replies typically arrive within one business day.

text: How do I change my email address?
reference_answer: Go to Account Settings, edit your email, and confirm via the verification link.

evidence_spans.quote: To change your email address, go to Account Settings, edit your email, and confirm the change using the verification link sent to the new address.

text: Where can I download the mobile app?
reference_answer: From the App Store or Google Play.

evidence_spans.quote: The mobile app is available for iOS and Android. Search for the app name in the App Store or Google Play and sign in with your existing account.

text: If my express shipping is late, how fast should it normally arrive, and when can I contact support about it?

evidence_spans.quote: Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and is available at checkout.
